newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Gudang Garam down on new MSCI index.
newsitem.headline: Gudang Garam down on new MSCI index.

text.p: Indonesian cigarette company PT Gudang Garam plunged 8.09 percent in early trade on Thursday following market talk that Morgan Stanley Captal Index (MSCI) had reduced its weighting on the stock, brokers said.
Gudang Garam fell 825 rupiah to 9,375 rupiah with about 721,000 shares changing hands by 0330 GMT.
"I heard Morgan Stanley had issued the new indices and some stocks were omitted or had their weighting reduced," an analyst with a foreign brokerage said.
He said Gudang Garam's weighting had been downgraded but no details were immediately available.

Brokers said investors were also snapping up some stocks which are said to have been included in the new index such as blue chip Bank Negara Indonesia, toll road operator Citra Marga Nusaphala Persada and conglomerate Bimantara Citra.
An MSCI spokesman said in Hong Kong that Bank Negara had been included the MSCI roster of companies which will be announced at the next regular reshuffle on May 30.
Bank Negara was up 125 rupiah at 1,475 at 0335 GMT.
